title: Local files
lede: We read your folder (without reusing old subfolders), propose a BassOrder genre sort, then you decide to copy or move. Nothing changes until you confirm.
chooseFolderTip: Opens Windows Explorer to pick the folder to analyze
refreshTip: Re-reads tracks (tags, genres). Does not move any file.
removeFromHistoryTip: Removes this analysis from history. Files on disk are untouched.
needDesktopHint: To analyze a Windows folder, open BassOrder as a desktop app (not browser alone). Run pnpm tauri dev from PowerShell.
emptyBodyResume: Your past analyses are in History (left menu). You can also pick a new folder here — we read track info without moving anything.
emptyBodyStart: Click “Choose a music folder”. BassOrder ignores your current structure, reads tags / titles / artists, proposes a genre plan, then waits for your OK before writing anything to disk.
spotifyNudgeBody: Connect your account to enrich the genre dictionary. Your files don’t wait — you can keep sorting here.
step3: Copy or move tracks into folders (when ready)
kpiGoalReached: 85% goal reached — you can create folders
metricTracksHintDupes: Including {{count}} duplicate still in the bar
metricTracksHintDupes_plural: Including {{count}} duplicates still in the bar
metricTracksHintOk: Valid audio files in the folder
excludeHelp: Check what you do not want to copy or move — it also disappears from the plan. Files stay on disk; they just stop polluting the sort. Exclude all also removes them from the bar. Undo or Reinclude all to go back.
undoTip: Goes back one step (bar + plan). Nothing on disk is changed.
excludeAllTip: Removes duplicates, junk, and cut-at-3:00 from the bar, plan, and import.
reincludeAllTip: Puts duplicates, junk, and cut-at-3:00 back in the bar and plan.
importAllGoing: · the whole plan will go to import
nextYoutube: Many tracks without genre (often YouTube dumps). Run auto-detect first, then sort the rest manually.
nextUnknown: Some tracks have no clear genre. Complete automatically, then sort the rest by hand if needed.
nextNoReady: No genre folder ready. Sort tracks first (outside “No genre” / “Unreadable”), then import.
nextReady: Ready to import: {{folders}} genre folder · {{tracks}} track{{dupes}}.
nextReady_plural: Ready to import: {{folders}} genre folders · {{tracks}} tracks{{dupes}}.
guessGenresTip: Looks up genres via Spotify, filenames, iTunes / Deezer. Does not move any file.
manualSortTip: Sort one by one tracks still without genre
importSortTip: Explains the process, creates a folder where you want, then copies or moves tracks
importDisabledNoFolders: Sort tracks into genres before importing
importDisabledAllExcluded: Everything is excluded — uncheck a cleanup category
importDisabledOk: Pick a folder and create the genre tree on your PC
actionLegend: Import the sort = create genre folders where you want on the PC. Copy (recommended) leaves originals intact. Refresh analysis = re-read the folder without writing.
actionLegendGuessFirst: Guess genres first (nothing is written). Then you can sort manually or import the plan.
noAudioFound: No audio track found in this folder.
analysisInMemory: Analysis in memory ({{count}} tracks) — jobs keep running in the background. Come back here to show the plan.
searchGenreAria: Search a genre in the plan
sortByCountTitle: Sort folders from fullest to least full
selectFolderLeft: Select a folder on the left.
folderSkipMeta: Excluded from sort, count, and import
folderWarnPending: {{count}} still in other folders (view, not disk folder)
folderWarnIsolated: Isolated in the plan · exact 3:00 duration
folderSkipTitle: Copies of the same track — excluded from count and import
folderWarnTitle: Files that last exactly 3:00 — often incomplete downloads
detailKickerDupes: Discarded copies — not a disk folder
detailKickerTruncPending: Duration view — not a disk folder yet
detailPathDupes: Excluded from count and import — they won’t be copied
detailPathTruncPending: {{count}} still sorted in a genre · isolate them or check the option at import
detailPathTruncReady: Isolated in the plan · “Cut at 3:00” folder at import
truncNote: These files show exactly 3:00. Many are cut mid-track. This list is a view: for a real disk folder, isolate them here or check the option at import (“Cut at 3:00”).
alreadyOnlyTrunc: All these tracks are already only in “Cut at 3:00”.
dupeNote: Same track in several files (title / artist, or almost identical name). We keep the best copy (quality, tags, duration) in the plan. These copies are out of count and will not be imported.
isolateTitle: Remove from genre folders — only in Cut at 3:00
resultNothing: Nothing to do — tracks are already sorted.
resultErrors: {{count}} error — writing may be partial. In move mode, refresh analysis before retrying.
resultErrors_plural: {{count}} errors — writing may be partial. In move mode, refresh analysis before retrying.
toastNoChangeAllOut: Everything is already out of the bar and import. Click “Reinclude all” or “Undo” to see them again.
toastNothingToUndoBody: No previous filter. Uncheck a box or click “Reinclude all”.
toastPrevStepBody: The bar and plan went back. Your files were not modified.
toastAlreadyIsolatedBody: All these 3:00 tracks are already only in “Cut at 3:00”.
toastIsolatedBody: Removed from genre folders — only in “Cut at 3:00”.
toastIncompleteBody: Track details are no longer cached — run analysis again.
toastRemovedHistoryBody: This analysis no longer appears here. Files on disk were not modified.
toastNeedDesktopBody: Relaunch with pnpm tauri dev to read your library.
toastScanBody: Reading track info (artist, genre…). No file is moved for now.
toastDupesCulledBody: Copies of the same track: out of count, out of import. The best copy stays sorted.
toastDupesCulledBodyShort: Copies of the same track: out of count, out of import.
toastLookupBody: We cross filenames, Spotify base, then online catalogs. No file is moved.
toastLookupDelta: +{{delta}} points. Still {{unknown}} track to sort by hand if needed.
toastLookupDelta_plural: +{{delta}} points. Still {{unknown}} tracks to sort by hand if needed.
toastLookupFew: Few new genres found. Use “Sort manually” for the rest.
toastNothingToImportBody: Everything is excluded (junk, cut, duplicates…) or there is no track.
toastWillMove: You are about to move files
toastWillMoveBody: Tracks will leave their current location. A confirmation window will open.
toastPathsStaleBody: After a move, click “Refresh analysis” on the source folder (or analyze the destination).
toastManualBody: Click a folder then confirm. Keys 1–9 = direct validate. Esc closes.
toastImportBody: Choose where to create the library, copy or move, then start.
detailHintDupes: Same track in several files — the best copy stays sorted
detailHintTrunc: Exact 3:00 duration — often an incomplete download / rip
detailHintArtist: All tracks by {{artist}} in the library
detailHintFolder: Will be created under the destination on import: {{folder}}
reasonCurrentState: Current state (run detection again for details)
